name: War of the Five Kingdoms — Strategic Campaign Map

northwatch.strategicRole: Northern political center controlling the King's Pass approaches.

stoneford.strategicRole: Western fortress controlling the mountain approach.

riverhold.strategicRole: Northern regional market tying the eastern valleys together.

highcrest.strategicRole: Eastern trade town on the cold coastal approach.

wolfpine.strategicRole: Dense snow-forest logging village below Wolf Ridge.

ironfrost.strategicRole: Mountain mine supplying northern stone and metal.

icewatch.strategicRole: Fortress controlling the eastern northern approach.

moorhall.strategicRole: Forest capital governing the western woodland roads.

blackfen.strategicRole: Regional forest city linking timber villages to central markets.

greywatch.strategicRole: Border fortress controlling the forest-to-plains road.

deepwood.strategicRole: Woodland market deep inside the western forest.

oakmarket.strategicRole: Southern forest market joining timber and farm routes.

oakrest.strategicRole: Logging and farming village on the Oakmarket road.

greenfield-west.strategicRole: Productive farming village in a broad woodland clearing.

oakshield.strategicRole: Castle controlling the southern forest road.

sunspire.strategicRole: Rich central capital commanding the primary road network.

goldmeadow.strategicRole: Fertile city and agricultural collection point.

redfield.strategicRole: High-output farming village supporting central food supply.

southgate.strategicRole: Western castle protecting the central realm from the forest frontier.

kingscross.strategicRole: Major crossroads whose control opens several campaign routes.

greenmead.strategicRole: Farming village between Goldmeadow and South Cross.

stonehill.strategicRole: High-ground castle controlling the northeast approach.

eastkeep.strategicRole: Eastern capital overlooking open military corridors.

greenharbor.strategicRole: Fertile eastern city supporting the main east-west road.

elmstead.strategicRole: Productive farming village on the southern eastern plain.

dawnfort.strategicRole: Fortress guarding the eastern frontier and coast road.

suncrest.strategicRole: Open-plains trade town east of the capital.

greencrest.strategicRole: Rolling-hill market near the central frontier.

hillstead.strategicRole: Pastoral hill village below the northern ridge.

coastfield.strategicRole: Coastal market village and future naval trade anchor.

greencrest-fort.strategicRole: Border fortress protecting the central/eastern corridor.

ironhold.strategicRole: Rocky-desert capital dominating the eastern caravan network.

emberfall.strategicRole: Great caravan city at the center of the desert road system.

stonevein.strategicRole: Southern mine producing stone and metal.

ashguard.strategicRole: Castle controlling the rocky southern route.

redhaven.strategicRole: Rocky city combining mining and caravan wealth.

oasisfall.strategicRole: Oasis town controlling the western desert supply chain.

dustmarket.strategicRole: Eastern caravan market on the Ironhold road.

sunwell.strategicRole: Southern oasis town anchoring the western desert route.

redstone.strategicRole: Rocky-desert stone village on the eastern caravan route.

dunefield.strategicRole: Pastoral settlement at the edge of the deep dunes.

caravan-rest.strategicRole: Road village servicing merchants approaching Ironhold.

dunegate.strategicRole: Fortress controlling the central greenland-to-desert approach.

sunwatch.strategicRole: Fortress controlling the western desert entrance.

wolf-ridge.strategicRole: High ridge overlooking the western northern valleys.

western-frost-pass.strategicRole: Western infantry-favored invasion corridor into Northreach.

kings-pass.strategicRole: Fastest central northern corridor; narrow and heavily defensible.

eastern-ice-pass.strategicRole: Long eastern mountain approach linking Riverhold to Stonehill.

frozen-valley.strategicRole: Open frozen valley connecting the northern approaches.

snowpine-crossing.strategicRole: Snowy woodland crossing where cavalry maneuver is restricted.

whitepass-ford.strategicRole: Cold river crossing below the eastern ridge.

deepwood-crossing.strategicRole: Forest junction tying Blackfen, Moorhall and Deepwood together.

greywood-hill.strategicRole: Forest hill: excellent ground for infantry against cavalry.

old-oak-road.strategicRole: Secondary woodland route around the main Greywatch road.

western-clearing.strategicRole: Broad clearing suitable for assembly before the southern road.

blackwood-ridge.strategicRole: Wooded ridge controlling Deepwood's southern approach.

west-road-clearing.strategicRole: Open clearing between Greywatch and the central frontier.

central-hill.strategicRole: Central high ground overlooking the southern route.

kings-road-junction.strategicRole: Major road junction immediately south of Sunspire.

west-road-junction.strategicRole: Western gateway between forest and central farmland.

east-road-junction.strategicRole: Eastern gateway where routes toward Eastvale divide.

south-cross.strategicRole: Major junction controlling the central route into the desert.

watch-hill.strategicRole: Observation hill between Stonehill and Greencrest Fort.

green-valley.strategicRole: Fertile valley providing a safer southern approach from Westmoor.

crown-ridge.strategicRole: Ridge below King's Pass overlooking Sunspire.

stonebridge.strategicRole: Narrow bridge worth holding on the northeastern central road.

golden-road.strategicRole: Fast major road linking Eastkeep and Suncrest.

sun-ridge.strategicRole: Rolling ridge restricting cavalry near Dawnfort.

eastern-plain.strategicRole: Excellent cavalry ground between Eastkeep and Greenharbor.

east-coast-road.strategicRole: Coastal military road linking Dawnfort and Coastfield.

desert-gate-west.strategicRole: Western rocky entrance into the desert.

desert-gate-central.strategicRole: Central descent from fertile country into the caravan network.

west-oasis.strategicRole: Strategic water and supply point on the western caravan road.

caravan-cross.strategicRole: The desert's most important caravan junction.

red-dunes.strategicRole: Deep desert corridor: exposed and supply-intensive.

eastern-rocks.strategicRole: Rocky desert ground favoring defenders over cavalry.

southern-oasis.strategicRole: Southern water source joining Sunwell and Ashguard.

broken-ridge.strategicRole: Rocky ridge guarding the southern approach to Ironhold.

dry-ridge.strategicRole: Dry high ground overlooking the central desert gate.
